div.head: Rect 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 5.5
div.ab: Eac he sceal hwiltidum geara beon on ma|negum weorcum to hlafordes willan . toeacan benyrðe 7 bedripe 7 mædmæwecte . 7 gyf he wel gelend bið he sceal beon gehorsad þæt he mæge to hlafordes seame þæt syllan . oððe sylf lædan . swæðer him man tæce . 7 fela ðinga swa gerad man sceal don . eal ic nu atellan ne mæig . ðonne him forðsið gebyrige hede se hlaford ðæs he læfe bute hwet friges sy.

Also, he must sometimes [in] the year, be [working] at many tasks, according to the lord’s will, as well as ploughing as rent, and compulsory-reaping at harvest, and mowing the meadows. And if he is well-furnished with land he must be given a horse that he may lend it to deliver the lord’s burdens or deliver them himself, whichever he is ordered, and he must do many things, all of which I may not tell now. When he dies it is fitting that the lord cares for that which he leaves [behind], except for whatever might be free.

[5.2] Eac he sceal hwiltidum geara beon on manegum weorcum to hlafordes willan, toeacan benyrðe 7 bedripe 7 mædmæwecte. [5.3] 7 gyf he wel gelend bið, he sceal beon gehorsad, þæt he mæge to hlafordes seame þæt syllan oððe sylf lædan, swæðer him man tæce. [5.4] 7 fela ðinga swa gerad man sceal don; eal ic nu atellan ne mæig. [5.5] Ðonne him forðsið gebyrige, hede se hlaford ðæs he læfe, bute hwet friges sy.
